value.rationale: The primary source treats eyes as a distinctive class of hyperbolic components, but illustrates them only at period five. Establishing that the first eye already occurs at the smallest possible primitive period three is a motivated structural cutoff, and the exact algebraic band provides an open continuum of genuine examples plus sharp boundary heights for a canonical lift. The information is neither a mere renaming of a prior tongue nor a single unsupported numerical point. The classification is explicitly restricted to the indicated lift; it is not oversold as a census of all eyes.
